---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

What problem does this feature address? Why do you need it?

## Proposed Solution

How do you envision this working? Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Use Cases

Describe specific scenarios where this feature would be useful.

## Additional Context

Any other information, mockups, or examples from other tools.

## Would You Like to Contribute?

Are you interested in implementing this feature yourself?

- [ ] Yes, I can work on this
- [ ] No, but I'm willing to help test
- [ ] No, just suggesting
